topics.label: housing and urban planning policy
topics.definition: Systematic planning of urban and suburban areas and the housing within those areas

topics.label: policy towards indigenous people
topics.definition: Government progams and policies toward indigenous peoples, such as land allocation, rights protection and financial support

topics.label: pension and welfare policy
topics.definition: Government policies supporting citizens financially through programs such as unemployment payments, pensions and financial support for the poor

topics.label: personal weapon control policy
topics.definition: Government policies and regulations around the personal ownership of firearms and other weapons

topics.label: immigration policy
topics.definition: Policies around immigration into a country such as who may immigrate to a country, how many people are allowed in each year, deportation of illegal immigrants and integration programmes that help new immigrants assimilate to a country's culture

topics.label: nuclear policy
topics.definition: Government policies around the production of use of nuclear power and weapons

topics.label: regulation of industry
topics.definition: Government regulation dictating how companies operate

topics.label: food and drink regulations
topics.definition: Government policies relating to the production and selling of food and drink, including ensuring food safety

topics.label: international relations
topics.definition: Relations between nations through negotiation, treaty, or diplomacy

topics.label: diplomacy
topics.definition: Negotiations between representatives of nations or groups of nations and the diplomats who are involved in the talks

topics.label: summit meeting
topics.definition: Meetings between high-level government officials or heads of state for the purpose of diplomatic negotiations to ease international tensions or to discuss common goals

topics.label: treaty
topics.definition: A written agreement between international entities that is binding under international law

topics.label: economic sanction
topics.definition: Economic measures taken by one country or intergovernmental agency against another such as trade restrictions and embargoes

topics.label: foreign aid
topics.definition: Support from one nation to another for purposes such as disaster, general economic development or diplomacy

topics.label: international organisation
topics.definition: Organisation with members and functions that cross international borders

topics.label: refugees and internally displaced people
topics.definition: People seeking shelter or asylum in another region because of some fear of persecution, conflict, or natural disaster in their own region

topics.label: non-governmental organisation (NGO)
topics.definition: Groups officially outside of government that lobby, demonstrate or campaign on a wide range of issues such as economics, the environment and healthcare

topics.label: political prisoners and dissenters
topics.definition: Individuals who put themselves at risk by expressing their political views and the imprisonment of individuals who speak out against a political authority

topics.label: lobbying
topics.definition: Advocacy to influence legislators or government officials

topics.label: political system
topics.definition: The form of government that is observed, recognised or otherwise declared by a society or state

topics.label: democracy
topics.definition: Form of government in which the people hold the power, either directly or through elected officials

topics.label: dictatorship
topics.definition: Form of government in which a single individual or a small group of individuals hold power without the consent of the people

topics.label: belief systems
topics.definition: A set of beliefs prescribed by an institution or text often focusing on the worship of a higher power and the outlining of moral guidelines

topics.label: Buddhism
topics.definition: An Asian religion founded in the 6th century BC in India based on the teachings of the Buddha with the goal of overcoming suffering and transcending desire and the individual self to achieve nirvana

topics.label: Christianity
topics.definition: Religions that follow the teachings of Jesus Christ and the Bible

topics.label: Mormonism
topics.definition: Christian religion founded in New York State in the 1820s that follows the teachings of Joseph Smith and the *Book of Mormon*

topics.label: Christian Orthodoxy
topics.definition: Eastern rite churches which are characterised by their continuity with the apostolic church, their liturgy and their territorial churches, mainly in eastern and south-eastern Europe and the Middle East

topics.label: Protestantism
topics.definition: Christian denominations that were formed through the 16th century Reformation movement

topics.label: Confucianism
topics.definition: A system of thought and behaviour originating in ancient China and based on the teachings of the philosopher Confucius

topics.label: cult
topics.definition: A group that consists of followers who are fully devoted to a charismatic leader. Members are sometimes exploited financially or subject to emotional or physical harm

topics.label: Hinduism
topics.definition: A religion and social system originating in India that includes a caste system, a belief in reincarnation and the worship of multiple deities

topics.label: Islam
topics.definition: Monotheistic religion that considers Muhammad as a prophet and the Qur'an as holy scripture

topics.label: Jainism
topics.definition: A religion beginning in the 7th-5th century BC in India that teaches a path to spiritual purity and enlightenment through a disciplined mode of life founded upon the tradition of ahimsa, nonviolence to all living creatures

topics.label: Judaism
topics.definition: A monotheistic religion and culture that follows the teachings of the Torah

topics.label: nature religion
topics.definition: Religions that believe nature and the natural world is an embodiment of divinity, sacredness or spiritual power, including indigenous religions practiced in various parts of the world, and modern Pagan faiths, such as Wicca

topics.label: Zoroastrianism
topics.definition: A religion originating in ancient Iran following the teachings of the prophet Zoroaster, predicting the triumph of good over evil and exalting the benevolent deity of wisdom, Ahura Mazda (Wise Lord), as its supreme being

topics.label: Scientology
topics.definition: A set of beliefs and practices invented by American science fiction author L. Ron Hubbard asserting that a human is an immortal, spiritual being (Thetan) that is resident in a physical body

topics.label: Shintoism
topics.definition: An indigenous Japanese polytheistic religion that revolves around kami, supernatural entities believed to inhabit all things

topics.label: Sikhism
topics.definition: An Indian Dharmic religion that originated at the end of the 15th century CE in the Punjab region, developed from the spiritual teachings of Guru Nanak

topics.label: Taoism
topics.definition: A philosophical and spiritual tradition originating in the 4th century BCE in China which emphasizes living in harmony with the Tao, the source, pattern and substance of everything that exists

topics.label: Unificationism
topics.definition: A religion founded in 1954 in South Korea following the teachings of Rev. Syn Myung Moon and known for its mass wedding ceremonies

topics.label: religious conflict
topics.definition: Conflicts involving religious differences

topics.label: religious festival and holiday
topics.definition: Holy day or period of observance in a religion which is sometimes a public holiday

topics.label: Christmas
topics.definition: Christian holiday that celebrates the birth of Jesus Christ. Is also celebrated by many as a secular holiday.

topics.label: Easter
topics.definition: Christian festival commemorating the resurrection of Jesus Christ. Is also celebrated by many as a secular holiday.

topics.label: Pentecost
topics.definition: Christian festival, celebrated on the 50th day after Easter commemorating the descent of the Holy Spirit, also known as Whitsun

topics.label: Ramadan
topics.definition: Holy month of fasting in Islam concluding in Eid al-Fitr

topics.label: Yom Kippur
topics.definition: Most solemn of Jewish religious holidays, observed on the 10th day of the lunar month of tishri by fasting and prayer from sunset to sundown the following day

topics.label: religious ritual
topics.definition: Established religious rituals such as mass, baptism, prayer meetings and bar and bat mitzvah

topics.label: religious facility
topics.definition: Any facility where a group carries out its religious rites

topics.label: church
topics.definition: A building used as a place of worship for the Christian religion

topics.label: mosque
topics.definition: A building used as a place of worship for the Islamic religion

topics.label: synagogue
topics.definition: A building used as a place of worship for the Jewish religion

topics.label: relations between religion and government
topics.definition: Matters arising from the relationship between religions and a government, including the question of whether churches should pay taxes, the push to keep religion out of publicly funded institutions and the freedom, or lack of to wear religious symbols in a school setting

topics.label: religious leader
topics.definition: Person or persons who have a ritual, juridical or otherwise leading role in their respective church or religion

topics.label: pope
topics.definition: Head of the Roman Catholic Church worldwide

topics.label: religious text
topics.definition: Texts regarded as holy or important by a religion

topics.label: Bible
topics.definition: Holy book of Christianity

topics.label: Qur'an
topics.definition: Holy book of Islam

topics.label: Torah
topics.definition: Holy book of Judaism

topics.label: biomedical science
topics.definition: The application of biology-based science to medical fields such as research, health monitoring or medical treatment

topics.label: biotechnology
topics.definition: The scientific manipulation of living organisms and biological processes for scientific, medical or agricultural purposes

topics.label: dentistry
topics.definition: The medical profession and field of study devoted to diagnosing, preventing and treating oral conditions

topics.label: veterinary medicine
topics.definition: The medical profession and field of study devoted to diagnosis, prevention and treatment of medical conditions in animals

topics.label: mathematics
topics.definition: The study of structure, space, change and number in abstract, often using symbolic logic and language, and including subjects such as geometry, algebra or trigonometry

topics.label: mechanical engineering
topics.definition: The study and application of the design, construction and operation of mechanical systems

topics.label: natural science
topics.definition: The sciences that deal with matter, energy and the physical world, including physics, biology, chemistry and astronomy

topics.label: astronomy
topics.definition: The study of celestial objects through direct observation and theoretical models

topics.label: biology
topics.definition: The study of the anatomy, behaviour, origin, physiology and other aspects of living organisms

topics.label: botany
topics.definition: The study of the physical and physiological structure, genetics, ecology and other aspects of plants

topics.label: genetics
topics.definition: The study of genes in living organisms, and of their role in heredity, development or genetic adaptation

topics.label: palaeontology
topics.definition: The study of prehistoric life forms, geological periods and fossils

topics.label: physiology
topics.definition: The study of the vital processes, internal organs or functional mechanisms of living organisms

topics.label: zoology
topics.definition: The study of the biology, physiology, development, behaviour or other aspects of animals

topics.label: chemistry
topics.definition: The study of the composition and properties of matter on the scale of atoms and molecules, and of the reactions between compounds

topics.label: cosmology
topics.definition: The study of the origin, evolution, organisation and structure of the universe

topics.label: geology
topics.definition: The study of Earth's physical processes, material structures and its properties

topics.label: horticulture
topics.definition: The study and art of plant cultivation, including landscape and garden design and plant conservation

topics.label: marine science
topics.definition: The study of living organisms and environments in saltwater ecosystems

topics.label: meteorology
topics.definition: The study of atmospheric chemistry and physics, with a focus on weather forecasting

topics.label: physics
topics.definition: The study of the movement and structure of matter, and how it relates to energy

topics.label: electromagnetism
topics.definition: The study of the physical interactions between electrically charged particles and magnetic fields

topics.label: nuclear physics
topics.definition: The study of the structure and behaviour of atomic nuclei

topics.label: particle physics
topics.definition: The study of the nature, properties and interactions of the elementary particles that constitute matter

topics.label: scientific research
topics.definition: The scientific and methodical investigation of events, procedures and interactions to explain why they occur, or to find solutions for problems

topics.label: scientific innovation
topics.definition: The development or creation of new scientific or technological products or processes, such as biotech or artificial intelligence applications, robotic limbs or nanoscale cameras

topics.label: medical research
topics.definition: Investigation conducted in the fields of health and medicine, such as genetic studies, disease research or pharmaceutical drug trials

topics.label: scientific exploration
topics.definition: Land, sea or space journeys undertaken to discover new information

topics.label: space exploration
topics.definition: The scientific exploration of outer space through manned and unmanned missions

topics.label: scientific publication
topics.definition: Academic research findings published in a journal, book or thesis

topics.label: scientific institution
topics.definition: Institution that carries out or governs scientific work, such as the National Academy of Arts and Sciences

topics.label: social sciences
topics.definition: The study of human society in such aspects as linguistics, anthropology, economics or sociology

topics.label: anthropology
topics.definition: The study of human behaviour and social interactions across time

topics.label: archaeology
topics.definition: The study of human activity throughout time and cultural history, using artefacts left behind by ancient peoples

topics.label: economics
topics.definition: The study of the laws and principles of economies, such as the production and distribution of goods and services

topics.label: geography
topics.definition: The study of the physical features of the surface of Earth and its political divisions

topics.label: history
topics.definition: The study of human events of the past

topics.label: information science
topics.definition: The study and practice of collecting, classifying, storing, retrieving and disseminating information

topics.label: study of law
topics.definition: The study of legal systems and the philosophy of law

topics.label: linguistics
topics.definition: The study of all aspects of human language such as syntax, phonetics, written and spoken forms and variations over time

topics.label: philosophy
topics.definition: The study of the principles and fundamental questions about matters such as the mind, reason, morality or values

topics.label: political science
topics.definition: The study of the principles of political and governmental systems, political thought and practices

topics.label: psychology
topics.definition: The study of the human mind, mental characteristics and emotional processes

topics.label: sociology
topics.definition: The study of human social organisation, social relationships and societal changes

topics.label: scientific standards
topics.definition: Nationally or internationally established rules governing scientific and technological study and development, such as calibration standards for scientific tools or equipment

topics.label: technology and engineering
topics.definition: The study and practice of industrial or applied sciences such as physics, hydrodynamics or thermodynamics

topics.label: aerospace engineering
topics.definition: The study, design, development and construction of aircraft, spacecraft and missile systems

topics.label: rocketry
topics.definition: The study, design, development and construction of rockets

topics.label: agricultural technology
topics.definition: The study and development of techniques and machinery to improve agricultural management and productivity

topics.label: civil engineering
topics.definition: The study, design, development and construction of structures such as buildings, bridges, tunnels, irrigation and sewage systems, streets or railroads

topics.label: electronic engineering
topics.definition: The study, design, development and application of systems built on the exchange of electrical charges, such as consumer devices, communications systems or industrial computers

topics.label: identification technology
topics.definition: The study, development, application and ethical considerations of technological methods for identifying products, animals or people; including radio frequency, biometrics or face recognition

topics.label: information technology and computer science
topics.definition: The study and design of computer systems, software and networks

topics.label: materials science
topics.definition: The study of the composition, structure and properties of materials for their use in industry and manufacturing

topics.label: micro science
topics.definition: The study of and technologies built at a microscopic scale, such as microbiology or microcomputing

topics.label: nanotechnology
topics.definition: Manipulating objects at the molecular scale

topics.label: communities
topics.definition: A group of individuals actively sharing a common value or interest

topics.label: social networking
topics.definition: Social interactions, either in person or online, intended to share information and build relationships around common interests

topics.label: demographics
topics.definition: The study of human populations and their characteristics, for example statistics or trends around aging populations in a particular geographic region

topics.label: immigration
topics.definition: The movement of individuals or groups of people from one country to another

topics.label: emigration
topics.definition: Leaving one's country of residence to settle permanently elsewhere

topics.label: illegal immigration
topics.definition: The movement of individuals or groups of people from one country to another without legal authorisation from the destination country

topics.label: population and census
topics.definition: The official count of people living in a given geopolitical area, usually carried out by a governmental body

topics.label: discrimination
topics.definition: Unfair treatment of, or policies or practices against, individuals or groups of people on the basis of real or perceived membership in a group, such as race, sexual orientation, political or religious beliefs, age or height

topics.label: ageism
topics.definition: Discrimination against individuals or groups of people on the basis of age

topics.label: racism
topics.definition: Discrimination against individuals or groups of people on the basis of race

topics.label: religious discrimination
topics.definition: Unfair treatment of individuals or groups of people on the basis of their religious belief

topics.label: sexism
topics.definition: Discrimination against individuals or groups of people, usually women, on the basis of gender

topics.label: family
topics.definition: A group of people related genetically or by a legal bond, or who consider themselves part of a familial unit regardless of genetic or legal status

topics.label: adoption
topics.definition: The legal process of transferring parental rights to someone other than a person's birth parents, that person usually being a child

topics.label: Dating and Relationships
topics.definition: The development of an intimate connection between individuals, through various forms of activities enjoyed together, often leading to a legal or permanent union such as marriage

topics.label: divorce
topics.definition: The process by which a marriage is legally dissolved

topics.label: family planning
topics.definition: Services and education aimed at informing individual decisions about reproduction, such as fertility, in vitro fertilisation, contraception or abortion

topics.label: abortion
topics.definition: The intentional termination of a pregnancy for elective or medical reasons

topics.label: marriage
topics.definition: The legal or socially recognised union of individuals, which establishes rights and obligations between them

topics.label: parenting
topics.definition: The caring for and support of a child's physical, emotional, developmental and social needs from birth to adulthood

topics.label: demographic group
topics.definition: A subset of society with shared traits

topics.label: adults
topics.definition: People above an age set by law that entitles them to full liability and certain privileges such as the legal right to drink alcoholic beverages and to vote

topics.label: children
topics.definition: Young people, usually pre-pubescent, who are legally considered minors and are in a guardianship relationship with adults

topics.label: disabilities
topics.definition: Physical or mental conditions that limit a person's movements, senses, or activities

topics.label: LGBTQ
topics.definition: People who identify as lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender or queer

topics.label: gender
topics.definition: The classification of individuals as male, female, or a non-binary designation

topics.label: infants
topics.definition: Very young people, usually defined as being just born up to the age of two

topics.label: national or ethnic minority
topics.definition: Groups of people that form a minority on an ethnic or national basis, and their status or issues relating to the majority

topics.label: senior citizens
topics.definition: People having passed the age of retirement

topics.label: teenagers
topics.definition: Young people between the ages that describe childhood and adulthood

topics.label: social condition
topics.definition: The circumstances or state of affairs affecting a person's life, welfare and relations with others in a society

topics.label: homelessness
topics.definition: The social condition defined by lack of permanent residence, living in shelters or on streets, and the issues and problems associated with it

topics.label: poverty
topics.definition: The lack of sufficient resources and means to provide basic needs such as food, clothing or shelter for oneself and one's family

topics.label: social problem
topics.definition: Issues related to human rights, human welfare and other areas of societal concern

topics.label: abusive behaviour
topics.definition: Actions that intentionally harm another person or people, often on an ongoing basis, such as psychological or mental abuse, negligence, physical or sexual abuse and torture

topics.label: addiction
topics.definition: The habitual and compulsive use of substances such as alcohol or drugs, or behaviour such as gambling, gaming or sex, often causing detrimental effects on the body, brain, and relationships with others

topics.label: juvenile delinquency
topics.definition: Unlawful conduct perpetrated by minors, often on a repeated basis

topics.label: prostitution
topics.definition: The business of engaging in sexual activity in exchange for payment

topics.label: slavery
topics.definition: The ownership of people as property, and the involuntary servitude of those people to their owners, which includes unpaid labour and coerced actions

topics.label: values
topics.definition: A person's or group's principles or standards of behaviour, which guide their way of living and choices made

topics.label: death and dying
topics.definition: Social, medical and mental health issues relating to people at the end of their lives

topics.label: euthanasia
topics.definition: The practice of humanely ending the life of a person suffering from a terminal illness

topics.label: assisted suicide
topics.definition: The practice of assisting a person suffering from a terminal illness in the process of suicide, often with a physician's oversight

topics.label: suicide
topics.definition: The intentional taking of one's own life

topics.label: ethics
topics.definition: The moral values and standards that define right and wrong actions or decisions

topics.label: pornography
topics.definition: The depiction of sexually explicit acts in various media renditions, such as video or photos, often considered obscene or immoral

topics.label: sexual behaviour
topics.definition: The manner in which people express their sexuality in physical acts

topics.label: welfare
topics.definition: Help for those in need of food, housing, health and other services

topics.label: charity
topics.definition: The voluntary giving of money, food or other necessities to those in need

topics.label: long-term care
topics.definition: Services provided on an extended and ongoing basis to patients suffering from chronic illness or disability

topics.label: social services
topics.definition: Social programmes, usually publicly sponsored, aimed at promoting people's welfare, such as housing, health care or education services

topics.label: competition discipline
topics.definition: Different types of sport which can be executed in competitions

topics.label: American football
topics.definition: Team ball game that opposes two teams of 11 that have offence and defence sections. Each offence attempts to move an oval ball down the 120 yards long field. Points are scored by advancing the ball into the opposing team s end zone.

topics.label: archery
topics.definition: Archers use bows and arrows to aim at targets 1.22 metres in diameter which are on average 70 metres distant.

topics.label: crossbow shooting
topics.definition: Shooting with crossbow on targets from different distances

topics.label: longbow
topics.definition: Shooting with longbow on targets from different distances. The competition is held outdoors on an open (flat) field.

topics.label: athletics
topics.definition: Competitions involving foot races, jumping and throwing which can be on a track inside a stadium or on outside roads

topics.label: cross-country run
topics.definition: Competitors run over rough ground and not on a track

topics.label: decathlon
topics.definition: Individual men's competition which involves accumulating points in 10 different disciplines over two days: 1st day - 100m, long-jump, shot-putt, high-jump, 400m. 2nd day - 110m hurdles, discus, pole-vault, javelin and 1,500 metres.

topics.label: discus throw
topics.definition: Competitors stand in a netted circle with a 2.50 metres diameter and with a turning motion attempt to throw a discus weighing 2kg for men and 1kg for women as far as possible

topics.label: hammer throw
topics.definition: Competitors throw a hammer consisting of a metal ball, chain and handle as far as they can from a netted circle which is 2.13 metres in diameter. The hammer weighs 7.26kg for men and 4kg for women

topics.label: heptathlon
topics.definition: Competition involving seven separate disciplines over two days. 1st day - 100m hurdles, high jump, shot put, 200 metres. 2nd day - long-jump, javelin, 800 metres

topics.label: high jump
topics.definition: Competitors build up speed over a short sprint and then jump as high as possible over a horizontal bar

topics.label: hurdles
topics.definition: A sprint running race where athletes jump over a series of upright frames

topics.label: javelin throw
topics.definition: Competitors in a specially-designated throwing area attempt to fling a spear-like javelin as far as possible. The javelin weighs 800 grams for men and 600 grams for women.

topics.label: long distance run
topics.definition: A running race at distances for more than 1500 metres

topics.label: long jump
topics.definition: Competitors build up speed over a short sprint and then jump in one leap as far as possible

topics.label: middle distance run
topics.definition: A running race at distances for more than 400 metres and up to and including 1500 metres

topics.label: pentathlon
topics.definition: Only indoor, 60m hurdles, high jump, shot put, long jump, 800 m

topics.label: pole vault
topics.definition: Competitors use a flexible pole to propel themselves feet-first into the air and clear a bar which is raised higher at each round of jumps.

topics.label: race walking
topics.definition: A race requiring the competitor to have always one foot on the ground

topics.label: relay run
topics.definition: A team of athletes run a relay over identical distances

topics.label: shot put
topics.definition: Competitors stand in a circle with a 2.13 metres diameter and attempt to throw a metal ball weighing 7.26 kg for men and 4kg for women as far as possible. The longest throw wins.

topics.label: sprint run
topics.definition: A running race at distances of up to and including 400 metres

topics.label: triple jump
topics.definition: Competitors build up speed over a short sprint and then attempt to jump as far forward as they can using a hop, skip and a jump technique.

topics.label: Australian rules football
topics.definition: A form of football played by two teams of 18 competing on a pitch by running with and passing an oval ball. Points are scored by moving the ball between goal posts. Governed by the Australian Football League.

topics.label: badminton
topics.definition: Two players or two teams of two compete by hitting a shuttlecock weighing approximately five grams over a high net. The aim for each player/team is to prevent the shuttlecock landing on their side of the court.

topics.label: bandy
topics.definition: Played outdoors on ice. The size of the ice rink is about the size of a soccer field. Skates like ice hockey. A small hard ball is used for playing. Players play with sticks, much like in ice hockey, but the sticks are shorter and more rounded than in ice

topics.label: baseball
topics.definition: A game between two teams of nine played on an enclosed ground. The team which scores the most points wins. A point is scored when a player runs around the ground marked out by four bases. To do this he has to hit the ball thrown at him by a rival player.

topics.label: rubberball baseball
topics.definition: Sometimes called ''soft baseball,'' the game is played with a rubber baseball of varying degrees of hardness depending upon the age and level of the players.

topics.label: basketball
topics.definition: Game played between two teams of five - points are scored by placing the large inflated ball into a net fixed on a ring 3.05m above the ground.

topics.label: biathlon
topics.definition: A combination of cross-country skiing and target shooting on a 12.5 K course in a pursuit format.

topics.label: billiards
topics.definition: A cue sport with balls on a table without a specific order to play them

topics.label: bobsleigh
topics.definition: One, two or four people racing down a course in a sled that consists of a main hull, a frame, two axles and sets of runners. The total time of all heats in a competition is added together to determine the winner.

topics.label: boules
topics.definition: Collective name of a number of games where the common goal is to move the competitor's balls as close to a small target ball as possible, played on a grass or sand surface. Balls are thrown (as in petanque and boules) or rolled (as in lawn bowls or bocce).

topics.label: boxing
topics.definition: Combat sport in which two men/women fight using only their fists covered by padded gloves in a square ring measuring 6m a side. The fight is usually split into 12 rounds of three minutes each.

topics.label: bullfighting
topics.definition: Classical contest pitting man against the bull

topics.label: Canadian football
topics.definition: Team ball game that opposes two teams of 12 that have offence and defence sections. Each offence attempts to move an oval ball down the 150 yards long field. Points are scored by advancing the ball into the opposing team s end zone.

topics.label: canoeing
topics.definition: Competition involving canoes which are generally kneeled and paddled with a single-bladed paddle

topics.label: casting (fishing)
topics.definition: Using fishing equipment to hit a target and score points

topics.label: mountain climbing
topics.definition: Moving up mountains using hands and feet

topics.label: ice climbing
topics.definition: Climbing of ice features such as icefalls and frozen cliffs

topics.label: mountaineering
topics.definition: Competitive alpine climbing

topics.label: sport climbing
topics.definition: Sport climbing as a special category: individual competition, on an artificial wall with time measurement

topics.label: cricket
topics.definition: Ball sport involving two teams of 11 players, balls, bats and wickets. The aim is to score as many runs as possible, and to get the opposing team 'out'. A 'run' involves a player running between two wickets. The opposing team try to get their rivals 'out'

topics.label: croquet
topics.definition: Using mallets to hit a ball through hoops

topics.label: curling
topics.definition: A game played on ice with large flat round stones. A player throws the stone, aiming at a target. Teammates of the player who has thrown the stone can sweep the ice in front of the stone to help smooth its path towards the target.

topics.label: icestock sport
topics.definition: Similar to curling, played on targets on ice, different stones with straight handle and different rules, played in alpine countries

topics.label: cycling
topics.definition: A race over a given distance on bicycles.

topics.label: artistic cycling
topics.definition: Individual or teams on one or two bicycles in an arena. Points are awarded by a jury.

topics.label: bmx racing
topics.definition: Bicycle racing in with inline start and various obstacles over off-road circuits.

topics.label: cycle ball
topics.definition: Competitive team sport using bicycles. One team against another with two persons per team. The aim is for competitors to move the ball using the front and rear wheels without letting their feet touch the ground.

topics.label: mountain biking
